name: yt-studyflow-backend
//buildTimeDeps: typescript, prisma and the @types/* packages are build-time tools, but they live in dependencies on purpose. Render sets NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm skip devDependencies — tsc then has no type definitions and prisma generate has no CLI, and the build fails with hundreds of TS7006/TS7016/TS2580 errors. Keeping them in dependencies makes the build work with ANY build command, including a plain `npm install`. Do not move them back.
